title: deparia jiulungensis var. albosquamata
intro: Deparia jiulungensis var. albosquamata, commonly known as the albosquamata fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the genus Deparia. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Deparia jiulungensis var. albosquamata include its ability to modulate immune responses, inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant are mainly flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine.
